protocol: Frozen exploratory comparison on the already inspected PUD test partition and original supervised channel/checkpoint from the prior study. Evaluate all 279 sentences at both prespecified character costs, with no selection from these test outcomes. Fixed channel uses its label-conditional observation likelihood; fixed mixture starts each continuation with the declared independent regime prior after preserving its label posterior; adaptive retains each boundary's complete correlated regime/label posterior; null channel fixes the informative-regime prior to zero. All modes freeze segmenter, encoder, fitted channel and old latent-feature weights; phase and scalar surprise drives are zero. The new online state is Bayesian inference over fixed observation hypotheses for the same boundary, not online fitting of the older latent-feature dynamics. State resets per sentence. A separate fixed 4/16-character prefix probe supplies identical outcomes to all modes, isolating prequential outcome forecasting from differing acquired trajectories. Runtime never receives labels; probe labels are used only for final scoring. Document-group bootstrap shares resampled groups across the parallel languages. This is previously exposed translated text with earlier full-development checkpoint selection; no independent-corpus, semantic-information or production-readiness claim follows.
timing_protocol: One episode measurement after restoring the same warmed checkpoint and before scoring or serialization. Includes session planning, inference and observation processing; old latent-feature weight fitting is disabled in every mode. Conditions execute in a frozen hash order. These local sequential timings are descriptive. The common-observation probe is outside episode timing.
selection: none; both predeclared costs are evaluated
